title: EventsCatalog
description: A list of event types with the JSON Schema of each type's data. The built-in catalog is events/catalog.json; plugins that add emitters publish their own catalog in the same shape.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors.

version.description: Catalog version. Adding a type is a minor bump; changing a data shape is a major bump.

emitter.description: Emitter that produces this type. Equals the second segment of type.

chartscope.description: Usual chart scope of events of this type. machine for machine-wide events, agent for events about one agent, team for events about a branch.

dataSchema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) that the event's data must match.

example.description: An example data object that matches dataSchema.
